title: Wire or retire non-verb chat surface authority
head: 2c57f180864f2f79dd7db9e40bc6e436f3cecbac

decision.reason: No production path consumes a string-keyed surface classifier. The five listed labels do not form one runtime dispatch plane: roster-card and injection are ChatService verbs, lineage uses a typed guard, and the multiplexed chat stream intentionally accepts draft attaches then re-authorizes through typed ChatService reads on replay and every live yield. Wiring the map would create a duplicate authority plane and misstate current stream behavior.
decision.priorRulingFork: The prior audit classified authorityForSurface as an intentional dormant fail-closed seam. The owner subsequently ruled to choose the architecture-correct durable option and not preserve dead architecture merely to avoid work; the live caller trace selects retirement.

baseline.textual: Only declaration, auth barrel, and focused matrix tests referenced the classifier family; zero production runtime callers.

changes: Removed authorityForSurface, CHAT_NONVERB_SURFACES, CHAT_SURFACE_AUTHORITY, DENY and their barrel exports.
Made CHAT_AUTHORITIES file-local because it only derives the in-file authority union.
Removed tests that kept the dead classifier alive.
Corrected matrix and guard headers to describe the typed verb and stream authorization paths that actually execute.

postDeletion.textualCorroboration: rg over packages tests tooling scripts found zero retired symbol spellings.
postDeletion.astLens: pnpm ast testonly packages/server/src/domain/chat --max 500 completed over 139 TS files; authorityForSurface absent; three unrelated pre-existing test-only exports remained.

verification.command: pnpm exec biome check <4 changed files> --diagnostic-level=error
pnpm test:scoped chat stream + guard + lifecycle + read suites
verification.result: 174 pass, 29 fail in the two stream suites because concurrent #2536 schema hardening now rejects their short or prefix-mismatched ChatId fixtures before the stream executes; no changed #2545 file participates in those validation failures
